sources.snippet: If you're building vision systems and you're tired of collecting labelled datasets for every new category, zero-shot classification is the remedy. Google's TIPSv2-so400m14 is a vision-language model that can sort images into classes it has never seen during training — just give it a set of text prompts and it matches the visual content.
